judge_rubric.name: scd2_handling
judge_rubric.description: Is the Type 2 DIM_CUSTOMER (change-tracking on c_name) migrated as a dbt snapshot with a check strategy on c_name, rather than a plain table that loses history?

judge_rubric.name: logic_fidelity
judge_rubric.description: Do the marts reproduce the node graph: surrogate dim_customer_key = row_number over c_custkey, nation_name joined from stg_nation, and the fact at order grain with a dim_customer_key FK?

judge_rubric.name: decomposition
judge_rubric.description: Are Source->Stage->Dimension/Fact nodes mapped to seeds->staging->(intermediate)->snapshot+marts wired with ref()/source(), preserving the star-schema shape rather than a monolith? Splitting related logic across multiple related intermediate models is good practice, not a fault - do not penalize extra intermediate models.

judge_rubric.name: test_quality
judge_rubric.description: Are there meaningful tests - unique/not_null on c_custkey, o_orderkey and the surrogate key, plus a relationship/not_null on the fact's dim_customer_key - not just trivially present?
